solution:
names = ["基础薄弱", "基础中等", "学有余力", "明显偏科"]
values = [6, 5, 3, 2]
threshold = 3

picked = []
for i in range(len(names)):
    if values[i] >= threshold:
        picked.append(names[i])

print(picked)
